mission: Advise on rental tool use. Require a current inspection and no reported damage.
baseline: A drill has a current inspection. Can it be used?
unseen: A sander has a current inspection. Can it be used?
correction:
Ask whether any damage is reported before recommending use.
Keep this wording unchanged.

lesson.applicability: Rental tool use when damage status is not supplied
lesson.instruction: Ask whether any damage is reported and withhold a use recommendation until both inspection and damage status are known.
